statement: The airspace record shows sector 7 status as "open" with ban hours from 12:00 to 23:00, but I know sector 7 is closed airspace today due to the stadium event.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record contradicts the stated facts: "record shows sector 7 status as 'open' ... but I know sector 7 is closed airspace today due to the stadium event."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
